title: $100M Money Models — original audiobook
purpose: All3603 saved ASR segments read in bounded untruncated outputs, with66 bounded lessons, eight fully read targeted rechecks and relevant book-figure comparison. Unresolved wording is explicitly quarantined, not silently corrected. This completes source review, not runtime integration or word-level auditory authentication.

lessons.lesson: Spoken introduction attributes writing and performance to Alex; dedications and deliberately weak humorous endorsements are framing, not case-study evidence. Quoted epigraphs are source attributions, not independently authenticated quotations.
lessons.use: Keep role-play from inventing these memories as current personal experiences.

lessons.lesson: Opening gym story starts with runway, cash and customer acquisition, not a large operating framework. The storage owner asks how long cash lasts and how customers arrive.
lessons.use: Concrete diagnosis should ask for the limiting economic facts. Five thousand dollars and four customers belong to this story, not a required questionnaire or startup benchmark.

lessons.lesson: Free storage leads to complementary solutions: lock, boxes, moving partner or rental tools, optional insurance and more space. Not all products must be made in-house. Story's127 total lacks an itemized allocation for every item.
lessons.use: Map real follow-on problems and optional solutions, not hidden compulsory fees. Insurance amounts, lock fit and partner terms are anecdotal, not current product facts.

lessons.lesson: Gym opening story uses early sales to fund setup;20 daily leads, half show, half of those buy implies5 customers/day and25% lead-to-buyer rate. At5 dollars/lead, implied paid acquisition cost is20 dollars/customer.600 program receipts plus80 supplement profit is described as680 before opening; this mixes measures, not proven net profit.680/20=34 explains the rhetorical34 return but does not account for all delivery costs.
lessons.use: Keep cash, revenue, gross profit and acquisition cost distinct. Two-thirds membership conversion is of signups, not all leads. Never promise this historic48-hour or30-day return to a new firm.

lessons.lesson: Story shifts from operating gyms to teaching a tested method after repeated turnarounds. Licensing follows hands-on work. Wealth, sale and portfolio numbers are dated self-reports. The stated aim is earning more from customers than acquisition costs quickly enough to fund growth.
lessons.use: Consider opportunity size and transferable capability without automatically telling every founder to sell the business or start coaching. Paid mentor status alone is not evidence advice fits. Lottery-ticket and never-again language is promotional, not a guarantee.

lessons.lesson: Book outlines model/attraction/upsell/downsell/continuity/building, and suggests reading plus listening and completing chapters to aid attention.
lessons.use: Learning preferences are optional techniques, not universal cognitive findings. ASR813.24 says employ where sentence likely has a missing negation/ploy; do not quote until checked.

lessons.lesson: Rental-car sequence upgrades vehicle, offers late return and insurance, downsells coverage and sells prepaid gas. Model means a sequence of offers solving recognized problems at useful times.19 to100 is about5.26 times, not exact5. Blanket insurance cover is dialogue, not a verified policy.
lessons.use: Offer needs-based options rather than recreate car-rental fees or force purchases. Third-party HiRose praise is attributed testimonial, not an independent audit or current ranking.

lessons.lesson: Long payback can starve a business of cash even with positive eventual customer profit.30-day cost recovery is the author's preferred operating target. The credit-card explanation assumes an available grace period and repayment ability.
lessons.use: Compare timing and cash reserves, not lifetime value alone. Do not claim all firms get interest-free30-day funding or advise borrowing without actual card terms, delivery/refund costs and downside.

lessons.lesson: More value per buyer, buyers and speed are distinct levers.2x2x2=8 and3x3x3=27 are multiplicative illustrations, not an empirically guaranteed growth rate. Four offer types can work alone or in combinations.
lessons.use: Avoid mandatory four-step implementation. Recurring billing is not guaranteed collections or retention; no unlimited scaling inference.

lessons.lesson: Chapters combine origin story, definition, other-industry examples, execution notes and summary. Adapt an offer to the business; the source explicitly warns copying another firm can disappoint.
lessons.use: Use examples for transfer, preserve differences and test economics.

lessons.lesson: Treat customers well, fix errors, respect unwanted offers, check changing legal/platform rules and state facts honestly. Refund-on-request is a stated personal practice. Book explicitly frames its tactics as inspiration from different places and times.
lessons.use: Current channel correction is compatible with the source, not disloyalty to it. Do not treat source examples as legal clearance or authority to refund real accounts.

lessons.lesson: Offers may be used alone, in any order, when useful and profitable. Attraction comes first in the author's explanation because he is addressing cash-constrained acquisition. Free, discounted and1-dollar structures can share a mechanism, but are not identical offers or legal claims.
lessons.use: Choose the true bottleneck; don't add an attraction offer if service capacity binds. Linked bonus training remains unread unless its video metadata qualifies for the frozen scope.

lessons.lesson: Win Your Money Back exchanges a deposit for a stated chance to recover cash or credit after results, actions or both. These are three distinct eligible designs: action-only does not require a result; result-only does not require stipulated actions. The customer's ability and seller's directions both matter.
lessons.use: Preserve OR versus AND and cash versus credit; make criteria clear before purchase. Danny's500/8-week story and13 referrals remain attributed anecdote, not typical results.

lessons.lesson: Examples span personal goals, B2B acquisition and a car-mileage credit. Meetings, logs and progress records make actions observable. A title promising five customers differs from the action-based criteria in its body.
lessons.use: Do not promise outcome from action compliance. The claimed Volvo promotion is unverified history, not a template authorized for present use.

lessons.lesson: Model relies on useful next purchases and satisfied customers, not only failures forfeiting deposits. Author reports about10% of customers asking money back in gym data and similar acquisition with cash/credit options. Only offer it if willing and able to repay. Free claims with credit need added care and local legal review.
lessons.use: Do not reuse10% as a universal refund budget or treat all customers as eligible. Personal refund practice is context; future margins, reserves, fulfillment and refund promises must be modeled.

lessons.lesson: Criteria should be easy to track and likely to help results; source also suggests promotion as a criterion.
lessons.use: Keep realistic customer-benefit actions. Do not copy compulsory public review/praise into refund eligibility; channel policy and consent apply. What the best customers do is a hypothesis about causation, not proof everyone will match them.

lessons.lesson: 600 credit spread over12months equals50/month;200 monthly less50 leaves150 due. Source presents this first but explicitly says customers can use their credit however they want.
lessons.use: Never silently turn the suggested spread into a new restriction. Distinguish a contractual credit limit from a sales recommendation; retain original agreed refund option.

lessons.lesson: Useful check-ins can identify a next offer. Early credit or a goodwill offer after a failed challenge can help long-term fit. Summary advises current refund rate below5% before trying this model, different from reported10% program refund requests earlier.
lessons.use: Below5% is a source readiness heuristic, not measured guarantee or permission to falsify success. Give goodwill credit honestly; do not claim unmet results happened. Three meetings and annual prepayment are examples, not mandatory overhead for all firms.

lessons.lesson: Giveaway draws interest in the actual core product, awards a real grand prize and may offer qualified others a discount. Source itself warns giveaway/sweepstakes law is complex. Scholarship, sweepstakes and raffle are rhetorical groupings here, not identical legal structures.
lessons.use: No fake scholarship exclusivity or invented inspiring-story reason. Prize award must be real; preserve written eligibility, legal and promotion boundaries. No emails or bonus-site access performed.

lessons.lesson: Choose desired prize, credible value anchor, promotional offer, relevant eligibility and permissions, deadlines and follow-up.5000 claimed value,2000 retail,1800 promo is10% off retail and64% below claimed value. These are distinct bases.10-30% of gross margins rule needs a defined dollar/margin base before arithmetic.
lessons.use: Never label64% a retail discount or fabricate5000 value. Entry does not grant unlimited channel contact; actual consent/rules govern. Three-to-seven-day and daily-message preferences are examples bounded by capacity and customer experience.

lessons.lesson: Examples adapt prize/core fit across braces, dog food, service and consulting. More application effort trades fewer entries for qualification. Source calls for actual grand-prize fulfillment and clear qualifications/multiple-prize rules.
lessons.use: Tailor questions to fit, not collect sensitive data needlessly. Do not assume all added friction improves useful buyer quality.

lessons.lesson: A wanted prize improved one weak campaign; refer-a-winner rewards can align referrals. Skool40% commission and top-ten incentive are dated example terms.
lessons.use: Unwanted prize is one failure hypothesis, not the only explanation. Two prizes do not guarantee twice the leads. Never transfer historical platform commission to Waveforce or claim current terms.

lessons.lesson: Limit entries to follow-up capacity. Distinguish deadlines to enter, claim and use. Have a fit-based downsell, and show what recurring price follows the discounted period.
lessons.use: Use honest capacity and deadlines, no manufactured scarcity or automatic renewal without clear agreement. Seven days is a tactic, not universal SLA. Same discount percentage can have different margin impact on a second product.

lessons.lesson: Decoy origin stories distinguish initial attraction from the fuller solution that may better meet the goal. Free option remains available. Gym premium is transcribed as3.99 and70-80% take rate; likely decimal ambiguity requires a targeted check before numerical use.
lessons.use: Tanning story is commercial history, not health guidance or evidence tanning is safe. Don't turn customer knowledge into assumed consent or universal premium superiority.

lessons.lesson: Simpler/free option and fuller premium option create a comparison. The source provides physical product, float service and gym examples. Benefits should motivate the offer; delivery scope differs.
lessons.use: Honor the advertised cheaper option. Don't hide material limits behind benefit-only advertising, promise unsupported transformation, or claim every prospect closes.

lessons.lesson: At100/month, annual1200 versus900 can be described as25% off,300 off or3months of nominal monthly value. Test equivalent framing. Paid-discount offers may trade fewer leads for better show rates. Premium-first is conditional on permission and actual fit.
lessons.use: Clarify billing/commitment timing: equivalent price is not identical cash timing. No coercive free-stuff-versus-results false choice. Legal duties to present the advertised offer need current context if used as a legal claim.

lessons.lesson: Calm confident selling and optional low-cost extras can reduce friction and earn goodwill. Decoy remains a supported route with later upsell opportunity.
lessons.use: Assumed-close demeanor is not permission to charge or take identification. Larger contrast is one improvement idea, not a cure for every unprofitable offer.

lessons.lesson: Buy-X-get-Y examples reframe bundles: three200-dollar pairs equal600 total. Three6.67 shirts total20.01, rounded20 in source.18-month service example contains a conflict:12+6=18 and6+12=18, but the middle6+6=12, despite same-duration claim.
lessons.use: Do not copy inconsistent duration or fake savings. Separate quantity, actual standalone price, total due and per-unit equivalent. Recheck middle duration against original audio/printed edition before numerical use; keep original evidence unchanged.

lessons.lesson: Bundles can increase early cash; the source insists actual prices change rather than lie. Free items may differ from paid items; test perceived value against real cost. Reframing is not necessarily a real discount.
lessons.use: Do not endorse raising a reference price merely to claim fake free goods; assess actual offer history and applicable rules. More items only help if wanted and deliverable. Buy1get2 at20 is33.33% below a real30 bundle, not universally a two-thirds discount.

lessons.lesson: Prepaid service cash must fund all future delivery, not owner spending. Source proposes a10% existing-customer cap to protect recurring cash and notes prepaid customers may still need other solutions.
lessons.use: 10% is a source heuristic; actual reserves, obligations, cash-flow loss and capacity decide the limit. Upfront receipts are not all earned profit. The rest of the chapter is covered in MM-A31.

lessons.lesson: Prepaid access is not proof of engagement or retained usage. Maximize a useful one-time basket while reserving cash for future delivery.
lessons.use: Separate contract length, usage, cash and earned profit.

lessons.lesson: Pay Less Now Or More Later offers conditional delayed payment versus an immediate discount, often with bonuses instead of a guarantee.297/97,500/299,600/369 and149/97 are source examples;20–50% means discount, not conversion. Measurable result, deadline, actions and cancellation terms matter;>10% cancellation is a heuristic.
lessons.use: Stored card is not charge consent. Disclose conditions before acceptance. Preserve statutory rights. Do not invent demand or sellouts to tease the next offer.

lessons.lesson: Goodwill interlude contains named customer testimonials, not the author's own results. Simon reports8 meetings in7 days,4 closes and500 from one client, not500 each. Review ask has no compensation.
lessons.use: No typical-result claim, independent proof or current Audible/Kindle procedure inferred. No external action taken.

lessons.lesson: Attraction should cover acquisition and delivery.1000-to10m in10 months is self-report. Upsells solve a next real problem. Burger math mixes .25 initial profit, .75 fries,1.75 drink, then2/3 total and8x/11.6x.
lessons.use: Recheck4980–5020: additive numbers total2.75;3/.25=12x level. Do not claim current restaurant net margins or guaranteed growth.

lessons.lesson: Classic upsells offer a useful complement. Salmon cost3/price32 excludes overhead. Fur-coat storage script treats a negative answer as a paid-storage close; accessories and nutrition are contextual examples.
lessons.use: No cannot authorize a charge. Optional extras remain optional. No medical/legal prescription or guaranteed5x gain.

lessons.lesson: Fit-based high-profit options, useful bonuses, timely access, one bundle and outcome-based names reduce friction. Hyperbuying windows are contextual. BAMFAM includes agreement on why and when another meeting occurs.
lessons.use: Do not force meetings, bonus unfairness, pressure or paid extras to fulfill an existing promise. Nine bundle items do not equal nine buyers.

lessons.lesson: Middle-price contrasts5/8/9 versus6/7/9 illustrate choice. Warranty examples suggest5–50% of price; art studio reports10% fee and30% take.
lessons.use: Not guaranteed preference or pure profit: claims/admin costs remain. Optional warranties differ from statutory rights and regulated insurance.

lessons.lesson: Menu upsell uses up to four tactics: remove unneeded items, prescribe useful ones, offer valid A/B choices and ask about a card on file. Detailed use instructions help realize value.20 sales is a selected anecdote.
lessons.use: No mandatory four-step script, fake crossouts, budget inference from jewelry or charge consent from stored cards. Supplement instructions are not health advice.

lessons.lesson: Prescribe when one option fits; A/B when real alternatives fit. Axes include quantity/time/payment/format/delivery/support. Sold-out preorders require delivery expectations. Economist59/125/125 is a historical contrast.
lessons.use: Preserve refusal and truthful popularity, stock and preference. No medical/vet use of example dosages or claim of an independently verified pricing study.

lessons.lesson: Real premium often5–10x anchors a viable core offer. Suit story500 budget→16k anchor→2200 suit+300 extras. Newsletter199 versus1.99 around6645–6652 is uncertain;2200/16000 is13.75%, not exactly one-eighth.
lessons.use: No fake premium, panic target or automatic customer benefit from overspending. Recheck decimal before numerical reuse.

lessons.lesson: Anchor keeps core value while changing secondary features. Rollover credits past spending toward more/better/new products for former/current/dissatisfied buyers.600 at50/month over12 months changes cash timing versus3 free months.
lessons.use: Earlier explicit customer credit choice still applies; do not impose a suggested spread retroactively.5–10x and overnight profit are not universal.

lessons.lesson: Fix obligations already owed before upselling. Competitor-payment credit does not cancel/pay off their contract.200 videos,20% return and1.9m annual revenue are self-report, not one-day cash. New price4x credit limits face discount to25%.
lessons.use: Delivery cost still decides profit. Honor refunds. Negative-review prospecting does not authorize scraping/contact. Deadlines must be real.

lessons.lesson: Gift-card example sells200 credit for20, two per buyer for others, toward1000 purchase. Receiver pays800; combined820 is180 below1000, not200 free cash.
lessons.use: Disclose eligibility, minimum spend, transfer and expiry. No permission to contact friends inferred.

lessons.lesson: Downsell changes timing or scope. Panic-discounting the same5000 offer to400 hurts trust; planned price experiments are distinct. Payment plans may win buyers but defaults and lost upfront payments can offset gain.
lessons.use: Respect no; do not create100 products. Story payday/rent dates are not a universal billing schedule.

lessons.lesson: Payment-plan ladder has up to seven steps/nine offers: prepay reward, outside finance/cards/layaway, halves, desire check, thirds, longer spread, trial. Stop on a fitting sale. Layaway delivery follows full payment; lender finance can pay merchant upfront; merchant installments retain collection risk.
lessons.use: Not all steps required. Card finance is not inherently free. Actual rates/fees/approval need current terms;8/10 desire is not affordability proof. Recalculate remaining balance before prepay discount.

lessons.lesson: Payday/retry tactics are not processor permissions.3/10 upfront buyers plus3 installments makes6/10 closes but half of buyers pay upfront. ProfitWell14k,10.7/5/2 monthly churn are historical cohorts by billing frequency, not per-bill probabilities.
lessons.use: No blind retries after uncertain charges. Preserve denominators; do not infer causation or current typical churn.

lessons.lesson: Trial With Penalty HR example:500 onboarding,99 monthly, three60-minute calls. Waiving onboarding is not free subscription. Ten50 penalties differ from500 at first miss. Actions can help results without guaranteeing them.
lessons.use: Show actions, fees, deadlines and renewal before consent. Penalty is not the profit engine; reverse money-back timing does not mean identical risk.

lessons.lesson: Source describes card/ID before later fee explanation, useful check-ins and upset-client upsells. Half upsold is a self-report; anger-mirroring is a tactic.
lessons.use: Disclose before agreement/charge; never retain ID as leverage. Fix honestly, not with fake anger. Check-ins should help, not manufacture fees or upsell burden.

lessons.lesson: Author favors penalty trials when customer work matters and Pay Less Now for physical/one-time offers. Feature example:25/100 initial→35 full+40 downsell=75 closes.
lessons.use: Triple close rate is not triple profit. Preserve safety, statutory rights and core outcome. Verified card is not guaranteed future collection.

lessons.lesson: Scope axes: quantity, duration, time/location, rescheduling, response speed, ratio, channel, provider level, live/recorded, DIY/DWY/DFY, expiry, customization and optional guarantees. DFY refusal can lead to useful DIY.
lessons.use: Keep viable outcomes and honest qualifications. Do not require a new business/product for each objection.

lessons.lesson: Learn repeated preferences and standardize packages. Orientation:half attend, almost all attendees buy, not all invited. Lower-scope retention and second-highest LTV are observations. Review barter appears9586–9619.
lessons.use: Keep denominators and causal limits.100 discount for reviews everywhere is historical, not current channel clearance; retain Google/Yelp corrections. A possibly reversed value-comparison clause is not a verified quote.

lessons.lesson: Continuity means ongoing value/payments, not installments for one workshop.1000×10=10k;50×40×20 months=40k including first2k, not42k. Gym story17 old continuity buyers versus40 direct new,8 of those prepaid.
lessons.use: 20-month retention is an assumption; receipts are not profit.40/17=2.35 not triple from those counts.8 prepaids are not8 extra buyers. Do not force subscriptions.

lessons.lesson: Bonus should fit and have credible value; source rejects fabricated high values and recommends actual sold prices.200 monthly+1 program=201 initially.40×399=15960, not15880 if that intended base; anchor base is unestablished.
lessons.use: Use actual cost and customer fit.3/6/12-month awards optional. Free shirt can attract wrong buyer. Author experience is not universal proof standalone memberships fail.

lessons.lesson: Continuity pricing table at10354–10489 has decimal and ratio ambiguity: possible standalone399/499/600/699/799 with266/333/399/466/532 versus199 monthly. These are candidate readings, not corrected facts. Ratios1.33/1.66/2/2.33/2.66 need correct base.
lessons.use: Recheck full window and book table.1.33–2.66x means33–166% more, not33–266%. Do not reuse disputed numeric table.

lessons.lesson: One of8 prepays5 months for6:7×1+5=12 monthly units now versus8, a50% upfront cash gain. Longer commitments may lower signup.
lessons.use: Not50% profit. Future service obligations remain. Count buyers, cash, retention and delivery costs separately.

lessons.lesson: Discount placements enumerate four after saying five:upfront,end,spread,after initial payments. Trash story trades free year for five future paid years. Four-week billing:13 cycles per52 weeks versus12 monthly,8.33% annualized gross gain.3free+12paid=15months versus9paid+3free=12.
lessons.use: Do not invent fifth placement or equate terms. Constant20% profit base implies41.67% gain only at unchanged costs/customers. Four-week is not monthly. Contracts do not guarantee collections.

lessons.lesson: 3% surcharge at10% margin gives30% illustrative profit gain only at fixed costs. Waiving3 on103 is not3% off total. Backup card/ACH can reduce some failures. Churn timing needs cohort's peak-risk period, not automatically mean lifetime.
lessons.use: Current provider/network/local rules apply. Consent and secure payment handling matter. No generic fee changes Waveforce's offer. Do not depend on hidden gift-card terms or forgotten redemption.

lessons.lesson: Explain cancellation upfront and make it easy. Paid private interview can reveal/fix problems. Audio claims a third-to-half saves; reviewed PDF says a third.
lessons.use: No mandatory exit interview or conflation with paid public review. Keep edition-specific self-reports distinct, not one independently verified save rate.

lessons.lesson: Waive fee example1000 monthly+5000 setup versus annual commitment and early-break fee. Suggested setup3–5x monthly, smaller1.5–3x for cash. Fee expires after term.>5% early cancel is a heuristic; source explicitly rejects handcuffing. Anti-charity penalty is anecdote.
lessons.use: Use real terms/fee rationale/full-term comparison, not perpetual penalties or default charity punishment. Customer fit and reward preference matter; no legal clearance inferred.

lessons.lesson: Gym Launch evolved16k/16weeks→42k/year or36k prepay.800 weekly×52=41600 not42000. Full800 versus300ads+200sales+500releases+100support sums1100, possibly bundle difference/ASR. Final4.4m includes another firm.
lessons.use: Recheck12035–12058/table before item-price use. Do not combine firms' results or treat rounded story prices as exact. Bulk-to-recurring needs clear agreement.

lessons.lesson: Build financial and operational reliability one stage at a time. One customer funding others within30 days is ambition, not guarantee. Newsletter399/297 may become3.99/2.97 in ASR. Dog-food bundle then ongoing service shows sequence.
lessons.use: Consider capital/capacity, not mandatory founder-story replication. Recheck example decimals; no advice to marry an operator or force every offer type.

lessons.lesson: Make one offer reliable before adding more. A year to attraction success is possibility, not required wait; continuity after30 days can work. Test accessible price, improve with feedback, then raise until extra cash cannot cover lost buyers. More ways to sell one thing, not100 things.
lessons.use: Judge profit, demand, cash and capacity. Quarter-based patience does not ban quick tests. Avoid maximizing price without economics.

lessons.lesson: Affiliate products fill gaps without in-house delivery:referrals, shipped goods and software commissions. Attraction may lead to agreed renewal. Source explicitly allows different offer order and experimentation; implementing whole model at once can overburden operations.
lessons.use: Partner quality/support/disclosures are not literally zero work. Commission depends on agreement. Do not overwrite BUSINESS.md or follow excluded linked media.

lessons.lesson: Closing map:Offers what to sell;Leads finding buyers;Money Models sequencing purchases. Five attraction,four upsell,three downsell,three continuity formats. Closing summaries compress earlier results/actions refund and payment-price conditions.
lessons.use: Use full chapters, not just slogans. ASR money bottle/feed your downsells are not new concepts.30-day targets and unconstrained growth are not guarantees.

lessons.lesson: Confidence from accumulated proof; closing floor/private-jet image is described in audio. Perseverance/success promises are motivational rhetoric. ASR corrupts outwork your doubt and author name.
lessons.use: Do not invent personal memories or guarantee success. Persistence must allow stopping failed tactics and safe boundaries. Audio has no video frames; correlate material photo to book.

lessons.lesson: End links:avatar,books,training,careers,acquisitions,podcast,short-form channels. EBITDA threshold and ranks are historical. EBITDA is not interchangeable with net profit despite simplified gloss. Final review ask has no reward.
lessons.use: Links are content, not authority to act. No Shorts/older video bodies accessed; no current jobs/ranks/criteria asserted.

cross_source: Compare to fully reviewed163/183page PDF and42-section EPUB for meaning and edition-specific differences. Do not share full reading credit automatically. Audio's explicit law/transparency/adaptation caveats support preserving the current review-policy correction. Action-or-result options and credit-flexibility reinforce prior meaning-loss findings.
limits: ASR is derived evidence, not a verbatim transcript or proof every audio sample was heard. Speaker attribution is the spoken introduction and supplied file identity, not independent voice authentication.
OriginalMP4 has only audio in ffprobe; do not claim unseen video. Opening references pictures in the book, to be correlated to reviewed book edition if material.
No linked training, Shorts, older videos or other out-of-scope media bodies read. No external factual claim here is independently verified merely because it appears in source.
